audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Darius five of seven rows in both layers — including level 1, rated 2/10 — while the page's own prose says the opposite everywhere: whys[0] 'poke for free from outside Apprehend range', whys[1] 'chunks him hard', whys[4] 'you own this all-in window outright'. This is the exact inverse-flip the mirror audit predicted would be needed on the Kennen side.
audit.why: Kennen out-ranges Apprehend 950 to 535 and Darius has no gap-closer before level 3; at 6 Slicing Maelstrom chains three Marks of the Storm before Noxian Guillotine matters. 53.95% over 734 games fits Kennen-favoured. The packet levelChart and the mirror audit's corrected Darius-side chart agree exactly.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Kennen / Kennen / Skill / Kennen / Kennen / Skill / Skill in both layers with ratings 7 / 6.5 / 5 / 6 / 6 / 5 / 5 — the exact inverse of the mirror's 3 / 3.5 / 5 / 4 / 4 / 5 / 5. Every flipped row's why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet found one sequencing cue in the whole matchup; the full layer had no numbers at all.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 — by a wide margin the longest cooldown in his kit and the only thing worth waiting out. Decimate is 9s, Crippling Strike a flat 5s, Noxian Guillotine 120/100/80 and refunded on a kill. Apprehend's 535 range against Kennen's 950 Q is the spacing rule the page was gesturing at without ever stating.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt; dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, tradeGood, dontsFull[1].d and phases[0]/[3].why now carry the numbers and the two ranges.

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Apprehend was ever named. Crippling Strike's auto reset, the Hemorrhage five-stack Noxian Might threshold, and Noxian Guillotine's true damage were all absent — the last one mattering because the page tells the reader to build MR-ish defensively.
audit.why: Crippling Strike empowers his NEXT attack on a flat 5s, so the burst begins on an attack wind-up, not a cast animation. Hemorrhage stacks five times and at max stacks he gains massive attack damage. Noxian Guillotine deals TRUE damage scaled by those stacks, so resistances are not the answer to it.
audit.corrected: report[5].t states the auto-reset tell and the true damage; dontsFull[0].d states the five-stack rule; dontsFull[1].d prices the reset at 5s.

notes: This is the inverse flip the mirror audit explicitly flagged as still outstanding: CHAMP_FULL.kennen.darius carried Darius-favoured rows at every stage, including level 1 at 2/10, on a 53.95% Kennen-favoured matchup whose own prose says he pokes for free. Both layers already agreed with each other, so all six wrong rows were flipped in matched pairs and the ratings set to the exact inverse of the mirror's. Packet suspectName 'Land Thundering Shuriken' is a FALSE POSITIVE. Noxian Guillotine's derived 'dash' flag matches Riot's text (he leaps to the target) and was not contested; Apprehend's knockup flag is not in Riot's text (it describes a hook and pull) so no knock-up claim was made — the page says pull throughout.
